svg.title: Procure-to-Pay — BPMN teaching model
svg.desc: BPMN collaboration between an external supplier and Charles River Requester, Purchasing, Receiving, Accounts Payable, and Treasury lanes. A goods requirement proceeds through requisition, purchase order, goods receipt, invoice, and payment.
